bio.text: Dave Rowley, a Republican, represents District 5 in the Iowa Senate; the Iowa Legislature's biography, which lists Rowley as David D. Rowley, lists Rowley as serving a second term.

The biography describes Rowley as a retired insurance agent and musician, singer and songwriter, a past president of Independent Insurance Agents of Iowa, and a 2024 inductee of the Iowa Rock 'N Roll Hall of Fame.
It lists a B.A. in psychology from the University of Iowa, and says Rowley was born in 1954 in Cedar Rapids and has lived in Spirit Lake since moving there in 1996.
